title: VST Template
idiom: mid-century Munari-like two-colour screenprint, a drawn sheet folding into a box
hero_prompt: Mid-century two-colour screenprint in the playful manner of Bruno Munari, vermilion and slate blue on warm cream paper, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: along the left a flat sheet of paper with one single wavy line drawn across it; in the middle the same sheet lifted and folding up along its creases, the wave line still running across the folds; on the right the finished result, a small plain wooden box with two round knobs and a round speaker opening, standing ready, so the drawn sheet becomes a playable object in three steps left to right. Generous empty cream space.
icon_prompt: Screenprint emblem, a flat single-colour vermilion silhouette on a cream ground, no shading or gradients: a flat rectangle on the left carrying one bold wave line, joined by a single fold to a small box on the right with one round knob. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
